systems.owner: Direction des systèmes d'information et de communication (Dsic), Ministère de l'enseignement préscolaire, primaire, secondaire et de l'alphabétisation
systems.tiers: national; public and institutions verify state examination results online, Campus France checking transcripts against the ministry's records

systems.system: Géolocalisation des centres d'examen (tablet survey of examination centres)
systems.owner: Direction des systèmes d'information et de communication (Dsic), Ministère de l'enseignement préscolaire, primaire, secondaire et de l'alphabétisation
systems.tiers: ministry agents with tablets, examination centres (CEPE, BEPC, Bac) in each department; candidates look up their centre on a mobile device

note: Both systems unveiled on 27 March 2026 serve state examinations only (result verification and examination-centre logistics); neither is a record per learner that schools add to, so no fact.
